info.title: PaperGo headless DMS
info.description: One organization per SQLite deployment. Immutable schema/content revisions, SharePoint-style exclusive permission scopes, head/published projections, rich typed fields, reusable templates, saved queries, personal/shared smart folders with cross-collection navigation and classification, taxonomy, and typed relationships. Libraries with webdav_enabled are also served over WebDAV (RFC 4918 class 1 and 2) at /webdav/{libraryID}/, outside this contract; WebDAV accepts these bearer tokens or HTTP Basic with a WebDAV credential password.

post.summary: Apply an atomic batch of item operations
post.description: 1..100 item creates, updates/moves, publishes, unpublishes or deletes in one list/library and one transaction. Requires collection read and per-operation write/publish permissions. Existing items require a positive current version in the body and may occur only once. No collection If-Match is required. Folder operations and blob transfers are excluded. Create parent_id defaults to the collection; all targets and destinations stay in it. All revisions, projections, relationships and audit effects roll back on any failure, which reports operation_index when applicable. No retry deduplication. Request body limit: 1 MiB.

200.description: All operations committed. Compact results follow request order; no collection ETag.

scope_id.description: Nearest exclusive scope that supplies permissions.

Permissions.description: SharePoint-style exclusive scopes. An inherited resource has no local grants. Grants at the nearest exclusive ancestor apply; ancestors beyond it do not. Grants within a scope are additive. Reset with inherit=true and no grants. Denies are rejected.

type_id.description: Relationship type; it supplies the name, direction, attributes and cardinality.

UpdateField.description: Uses container If-Match. Key, type and scale are immutable. Changes affect future revisions; historical content retains its schema.

options.description: Complete replacement of options; multiple and reference scope are immutable.

edges.description: Schema snapshot included in revision history for interpreting historical values.

definition.description: Frozen collection field catalog and content_types array with ID, key, name, field_keys, rules and is_default. Each item revision uses its immutable content_type_id within this snapshot.

unique.description: Collection-wide exact, case-sensitive business key covering both head and published values. Requires indexed=true and a scalar type other than approximate number. Nulls do not reserve a key. Collisions return 409 and roll back the entire mutation or bulk batch.

content_type_id.description: Collection content type ID. Omission selects the collection default.

ApplyTemplateInput.description: Apply compatible shared catalog field definitions and merge rules by key into the selected content type (default when omitted), recording one frozen collection schema. Other type memberships are retained.

value_ref.description: Exclusive with value. me resolves to the authenticated subject; UTC date references require date/datetime fields and resolve to midnight for datetime. Plain value strings stay literal.

FilterExpr.description: One condition or AND/OR/NOT group; maximum 32 nodes and depth 6. Custom fields must be indexed. $id/$name are system fields; $tags supports equality. Multi-valued eq matches any member; ne requires present with no equal member.

content_type_id.description: Optional collection content type filter. Field filters, sorting and grouping must use fields assigned to that type.

QuerySpec.description: Collection query over visible surfaces. System fields: $id, $name, $tags, $created_at, $created_by, $modified_at, $modified_by. Times are RFC3339 UTC and modification metadata follows the selected revision.

ViewInput.description: Collection-managed saved view. Columns use field keys and $id/$name/$tags; empty columns default to $name. PUT replaces the definition. Layout is a client hint.

QueryGroup.description: Grouping key and authorized count before pagination. Integer and decimal keys are exact strings, booleans are booleans, absent values are null.

when_value.description: Non-null scalar value compatible with when_field

ValidationRule.description: Comparisons require other_field of the same scalar type and decimal scale; null operands skip comparison. required_if requires when_field and non-null when_value and requires field when those values are equal. Ordered comparisons exclude boolean, choice, lookup and term. Maximum 32 rules per type.

key.description: Required for creation, immutable. May be omitted for replacement.

field_keys.description: Keys from the shared collection field catalog.

ContentTypeInput.description: At most 32 content types per collection, with exactly one default. Replacements validate existing heads against the proposed fields and rules atomically. Selecting a default advances the former default type version.

indexed.description: Opt-in typed query projection. Changes rebuild both surfaces atomically.

scale.description: Immutable decimal scale; zero for all other field types. Scaled units must fit signed 64 bits.

SmartFolderDefinition.description: Live query across at most 100 readable collections. Name/key selectors ignore case. Terms include descendants and can occupy different term fields. Incompatible collection filters are skipped; none compatible returns validation. Metadata navigation is scalar and indexed, with compatible field types/scopes across collections. Physical folders have system metadata only and are excluded when term/content-type selectors are present. Equivalent collection predicates share one SQL branch; distinct shapes use UNION ALL. Queries are bounded to 30,000 SQL parameters.

SmartFolderInput.description: Personal folders are owner-only and may span all readable workspaces. Shared folders require workspace_id and workspace manage permission. Ownership and workspace are immutable on PUT; PUT replaces the definition. At most 100 shared folders per workspace. Shared mutations advance the workspace version; personal mutations do not.

path.description: One value per navigation level; null means missing. Numeric and boolean values use canonical strings, dates use YYYY or YYYY-MM when grouped.

SmartFolderResult.description: Recently modified first, ID ascending ties, permission filtering before pagination and totals. Cursors bind folder version, caller, surface, path, schemas and resolved references.

path.description: One value per navigation level; null means missing. Numeric and boolean values use canonical strings, dates use YYYY or YYYY-MM when grouped.

SmartFolderDrop.description: Classify existing item or create one through ordinary item validation/revisions/publication. Current folder_version is required. Inferred AND equalities, selected terms and writable path fields are applied; non-inferable predicates must already fit. The write rolls back unless the head matches the folder/path. Existing items retain location; new parent_id must belong to collection.

SmartFolderTermRef.description: Taxonomy set key and root-to-leaf term names, resolved in the target workspace.

PortableSmartFolderDefinition.description: Portable shared definition: named selectors and term paths, with filter literals retained literally.

SmartFolderPackage.description: Shared definitions only; personal folders and ownership IDs are excluded. Imports merge by exact unique name, preserve IDs and leave other definitions intact. Target taxonomy must exist. Any invalid entry rolls back the entire package. Identical reapplication changes no versions or audit records.
